publicly_readable: One article, reprinted on worldin.economist.com in 2015 for the 30th edition ("After communism", by Norman Macrae), read from an Internet Archive snapshot.
not_readable: Everything else in the issue. No other text of this edition was found in public form.
notes: Edition number counted from The World in 1987 = 1. Publication month not confirmed; year only. The reprint is The Economist's own web copy of the original article. The reprinted article is about the 1990s as a decade (for example that the Soviet Union "will certainly split into being more than one country") and holds no prediction dated to 1990.
